` }) export class HomeComponent implements OnInit { content!: PortfolioData; featuredProjects: any[] = []; downloading: boolean = false; constructor( private contentService: ContentService, private statsService: StatsService ) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.contentService.content$.subscribe(data => { this.content = data; this.featuredProjects = (data.projects || []).slice(0, 3); }); this.statsService.recordVisit(); } handleResumeDownload(): void { this.downloading = true; this.statsService.recordDownload(); const link = document.createElement('a'); link.href = '/Amit_Kumar_Maurya_Resume.pdf'; link.download = `${this.content.personalInfo.name || 'Amit_Kumar_Maurya'}_Resume.pdf`; document.body.appendChild(link); link.click(); document.body.removeChild(link); setTimeout(() => { this.downloading = false; }, 1200); } }
